bolds.text: 100% launch consistency across 85 global sites. Content volume scaled 10x with zero additional headcount.
New hires perform at expert level on day one, senior staff are never interrupted by routine problems again, and response times dropped from 3 days to 4 minutes.
31% more customers now resolve issues without a human, 12 hours of manual labor are recovered every week, and their best engineer effectively scales without limit.

Daily oversight dropped from 2.5 hours to 15 minutes, escalations are now caught 6 to 8 hours faster, and the entire system runs at $30–50 a month in infrastructure. Saves $1,200 to $1,400 every month without an ops coordinator.
